description: Source code for the BMI270 sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, including initialization, register access, data conversion, and configuration functions.

methods.name: bmi270_bus_check
methods.description: Checks the bus interface for the BMI270 device.

methods.name: bmi270_bus_init
methods.description: Initializes the bus interface for the BMI270 device.

methods.name: bmi270_reg_read
methods.description: Reads data from a register of the BMI270 device.

methods.name: bmi270_reg_write
methods.description: Writes data to a register of the BMI270 device.

methods.name: bmi270_reg_write_with_delay
methods.description: Writes to a register with a delay afterward.

methods.name: channel_accel_convert
methods.description: Converts raw accelerometer data to sensor_value format.

methods.name: channel_gyro_convert
methods.description: Converts raw gyroscope data to sensor_value format.

methods.name: acc_odr_to_reg
methods.description: Converts accelerometer ODR sensor_value to register value.

methods.name: set_accel_odr_osr
methods.description: Sets accelerometer ODR and oversampling rate.

methods.name: gyr_odr_to_reg
methods.description: Converts gyroscope ODR sensor_value to register value.

methods.name: set_gyro_odr_osr
methods.description: Sets gyroscope ODR and oversampling rate.

methods.name: write_config_file
methods.description: Writes configuration data to the BMI270 device.

methods.name: bmi270_attr_set
methods.description: Sets sensor attributes such as sampling frequency, range, etc.
